advice.wear: 🧣 Extreme cold: heavy coat, thermal layers, insulated boots.
advice.carry: ❄️ Keep hand warmers and extra layers; limit outdoor exposure.
advice.travel: 🚗 High risk of snowdrifts — avoid non-essential travel.
advice.home: 🏠 Protect pipes; ensure heating is on and vents clear.

advice.wear: 🧥 Freezing temps: warm coat, hat, gloves, sturdy footwear.
advice.carry: 🌂 Carry traction aids for shoes if walking on untreated surfaces.
advice.travel: ⚠️ Watch for black ice in mornings and evenings.
advice.home: 🔥 Keep a backup heat plan and check vehicle antifreeze.

advice.wear: 🧥 Very cold: coat and layers recommended.
advice.carry: 🌂 Umbrella or light waterproofing if precipitation expected.
advice.travel: ⚠️ Be cautious: slushy roads can hide patches of ice.
advice.home: 🏠 Dry entryways to reduce indoor slip risk.

advice.wear: 🧣 Cool weather: jacket or sweater recommended.
advice.carry: 🌂 Consider a light waterproof layer if wind/rain expected.
advice.home: 🪟 Ventilate in the morning; close windows if heavy rain or strong winds.

advice.wear: 👕 T-shirt weather. Light layers work well.
advice.home: 🏠 During heatwaves: keep blinds/curtains closed during midday, ventilate early morning/evening, use fans or AC to maintain cool interior.

heavy_rain.carry: 🌧️ Heavy rain: waterproof coat and umbrella.
heavy_rain.travel: 🚧 Flooding risk — avoid low-lying roads and drive slowly.
heavy_rain.home: 🧰 Check drainage and clear gutters if safe.

light_rain.carry: 🌦️ Light rain: small umbrella or water-resistant jacket.
light_rain.home: 🪟 Dry shoes and mats to avoid slips indoors.

snowfall.carry: ❄️ Snow: insulated boots, warm gloves, and hat.
snowfall.travel: 🚗 Snowy roads — consider snow tires/chains and reduced speed.
snowfall.home: 🏠 Clear paths and keep salt or grit handy.

flurries.carry: 🌨️ Flurries: light warm layer and good footwear.
flurries.travel: ⚠️ Brief slippery patches possible; drive carefully.

sleet.carry: 🧥 Sleet: waterproof outer layer and good traction footwear.
sleet.home: 🧰 Remove standing water to prevent freezing.

black_ice.travel: 🚨 Black ice risk: extremely slippery surfaces — avoid driving if possible.
black_ice.footwear: 🥿 Use shoes with good grip; walk slowly and test footing.
black_ice.home: 🧂 Keep grit/salt available for steps and porches.

moisture.very_dry: 🫧 Very dry air: moisturize generously, especially after washing; consider a humidifier indoors.
moisture.dry: 🧴 Dry conditions: use a richer moisturizer and keep lips protected.
moisture.moderate: 🧼 Moderate air: maintain normal hydration and use moisturizer if your skin feels tight.
moisture.humid: 💧 Humid conditions: lighter moisturizer is fine; avoid overloading heavy creams if you feel greasy.

wind.windy: 💨 Strong winds: secure loose outdoor items and avoid tall exposed routes.
wind.gale: 🌪️ Gale-force winds: stay indoors and avoid coastal promenades.
